scientific_question: Is the previously observed increment of the all-channel RiboKinetic function model over the no-channel and proxy baselines reproducible across fixed training seeds, rather than a single-seed favorable draw?
observed_phenomenon: At seed 20261119, ribokinetic_all improved over ribokinetic_none and ridge_gc on sequence-OOD, but did not significantly outperform ridge_all; a retrospective readout also found no significant advantage over HistGB. The experiment had only one training seed.
falsifiable_hypothesis: With architecture, optimization, data, split, and checkpoint-selection rules frozen, the mean sequence-OOD benefit of ribokinetic_all over every control is positive for Spearman and negative for cluster-balanced MSE, with hierarchical 95% bootstrap intervals excluding zero after Holm correction.
scope: Robustness analysis on already observed Boel cross-protein nonsynonymous train/dev/test/sequence-OOD data. This is not fixed-protein synonymous evidence, not an untouched confirmation, and not a generator experiment.
seed_selection: All four seeds are evaluated and reported. No seed, checkpoint, arm, or result may be selected using test or sequence-OOD.

training_contract.checkpoint_selection: minimum dev cluster-balanced MSE independently within each seed

endpoints.primary: sequence_ood cluster-balanced MSE, averaged over the four per-seed values
endpoints.secondary: sequence_ood row Spearman, averaged over the four per-seed values

statistics.estimand: Mean per-seed left-minus-right endpoint difference across all four fixed seeds; no prediction averaging and no ensemble claim.
statistics.bootstrap: Hierarchical resampling of operational protein clusters and the four training seeds, independently with replacement, using identical sampled clusters and seeds for paired methods.
statistics.pvalue: two-sided sign-tail probability on the benefit scale
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across all 8 sequence-OOD comparison-by-endpoint tests; test-partition results are descriptive and not gated
statistics.spearman_benefit: left minus right; support requires CI lower bound > 0
statistics.mse_benefit: right minus left on the benefit scale; raw delta remains left minus right and support requires CI upper bound < 0
statistics.seed_variance: Seed resampling represents algorithmic training-seed variability; cluster resampling represents held-out protein-cluster variability. Four seeds do not justify a normal-theory claim.

functional_robustness_pass_rule: All 8 sequence-OOD comparisons must have a statistically significant benefit in the required direction with Holm-adjusted p<0.05. No individual endpoint or subset is sufficient.
expected_evidence_if_supported: The all-channel advantage is stable across all fixed seeds and stronger than both linear and nonlinear full-proxy controls on the existing sequence-OOD partition.
refutation_conditions: Any all-versus-ridge_all or all-versus-histgb_all interval includes zero or favors the control.
Any all-versus-none or all-versus-ridge_gc comparison fails the frozen direction or multiplicity rule.
A favorable result depends on selecting one seed, averaging predictions into an unbudgeted ensemble, or removing a strong control.

decision.if_pass: Record only functional robustness on the existing OOD partition. Require independent fixed-protein/prospective confirmation and the other RK-G1 mechanisms before any generator authorization.
decision.if_fail: Retain the negative or uncertain result; do not add seeds or tune on test/OOD. Return to supervision/objective diagnosis rather than scaling or generator training.

cost_contract.baseline_costs: Reuse frozen baseline predictions; do not relabel baseline reuse as new training.
cost_contract.gpu_cotenancy: Other real experiments may share the GPU. These timings are robustness-run costs, not controlled time-matched SOTA evidence.
